title: The Drive that opened too wide
scenario:
You are the AI lead for a 12-person sales team at a furniture wholesaler. The team uses Claude on a Team plan. Your colleague Priya is the Owner. This week she plans to turn on the Google Drive and Gmail connectors.

Use the exhibit. The company, people and notes are made up for this case. Product facts are from the vendors' help pages in October 2026.
exhibit:
ROLLOUT NOTES (made up)

  Plan:  turn on Google Drive and Gmail connectors
         for the whole sales team this Friday.

QUESTIONS FROM THE TEAM
  1. Jonas (intern): "Once Drive is connected, can Claude
     read the Finance folder? I can't open it in Drive."
  2. Sam: "Priya turned Gmail on for the team, but Claude
     still can't read my mail."
  3. Head of sales: "Claude may search and summarize our
     email. It must never send email for anyone."
  4. IT: "Someone wants a custom connector that logs in
     to the CRM (the customer database) with
     one admin account for everybody."

questions.prompt: Question 1: what do you tell Jonas about the Finance folder?

options.text: Yes, because a connector gives Claude access to the whole Drive
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says Claude inherits each person's permissions. If Jonas can't open a file in Drive, the connector can't reach it either.

options.text: No, Claude sees only what Jonas's own Drive account can open
options.explanation: Right. The Claude Help Center says that if someone can't access a file in the source system, the connector can't reach it from Claude either. The ChatGPT docs say the same of the Drive plugin: signing in doesn't unlock other files or add Google Drive permissions.

options.text: Yes, but only after Priya approves each of his Finance requests
options.explanation: No Owner approval opens a folder Jonas can't open in Drive. The connector follows his own permissions.

options.text: No, because connectors can only read files that Jonas uploads
options.explanation: A Drive connector can search Drive itself. It just stays inside what Jonas's account can open.

questions.prompt: Question 2: why can't Sam's Claude read his mail yet?

options.text: Gmail can only be connected on a single-user plan, not on Team
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center describes how Owners enable connectors on Team and Enterprise plans. Team plans can use Gmail.

options.text: Priya must also give Sam her own Gmail password to finish setup
options.explanation: No password is shared. The Claude Help Center says each person still needs to authenticate individually with their own account.

options.text: Sam still has to sign in to Gmail himself to link his account
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: enabling a connector makes it available, but each person still needs to authenticate individually. OpenAI: installing a plugin for everyone doesn't, by itself, provide a shared account.

options.text: Claude reads mail only for the person who first turned it on
options.explanation: No page says that. Every member can use it after signing in to their own account.

questions.prompt: Question 3: how do you make sure Claude never sends email for anyone?

options.text: Set the Gmail send tools to Blocked in the connector settings
options.explanation: Right. Owners can set each tool to Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked, org-wide. Users can't override it. OpenAI also says to start with read actions.

options.text: Send a team memo asking people not to let Claude send email
options.explanation: A memo can be forgotten. Anthropic gives Owners an org-wide setting that users can't override.

options.text: Turn the Gmail connector off, so nobody can search mail at all
options.explanation: That also stops the search and summaries the head of sales wants. Restrict the send action instead.

options.text: Write "never send email" in each person's project description
options.explanation: That is not a permission setting. The org-wide tool setting is what blocks the action.

questions.prompt: Question 4: what is the risk of the CRM connector with one admin login?

options.text: None, because Claude still checks each person's CRM permissions
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says a custom connector with a shared credential reaches whatever that credential can access.

options.text: It can only read, so no one can change a record through Claude
options.explanation: No page says a shared login is read-only. Connectors can also take actions.

options.text: It runs slower, since every request goes through one account
options.explanation: Speed is not the issue the pages raise. The issue is what the shared login can reach.

options.text: Everyone reaches what the admin can, not just their own records
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: custom connectors that use a shared credential reach whatever that credential can access.
